title: Strip YAML block-scalar indicators from page summaries
notes: - Observation: a page whose frontmatter stores `summary: >-` (or `>`, `|`, `|-`) is listed in the generated index as `— >- <text>`, because `folded_value` joins the continuation lines but keeps the indicator, and `summary_of` only removes quotes.
- Next step: in `tools/index/summary_of.py` (or `folded_value.py`), drop a leading block indicator (`[>|][+-]?`) before unquoting, and add a test with a folded summary.
